periods.label: Mon 12 Oct
periods.text: Northerly 15 to 20 knots shifting southerly 20 to 30 knots in the evening. Squalls possible with the wind change. Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres south of Moruya Heads during the afternoon. Southerly below 1 metre. Mostly sunny. 70% chance of showers late this afternoon and evening. The chance of a thunderstorm during this afternoon and early evening.
